reason: My renderer is gone and I need someone reliable. A no-deposit trial on one of my current plans, paid only if I like it, is low risk, and $1,500 is small next to a custom home. I'd try it on one build and treat it as a line item on the architecture side.
objection: I wouldn't pay for it myself; the homeowner has to agree to it. Whether a client signs off on a $1,500 charge depends on the job. Also, is a one-day turnaround real, and does it hold up on the odd custom details my architects draw?
would_change_my_mind: If the lunch demo looked cheap or generic, or I couldn't pass the cost to the homeowner as a pre-construction line, I'd walk.
